articles.summary: EDGEWOOD, N.Y., May 26, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - CPI Aerostructures, Inc. (“CPI Aero®” or the “Company”) (NYSE American: CVU) announced that its wholly owned subsidiary, Welding Metallurgy, Inc. (WMI) has reached an Agreement with Northrop Grumman Corporation (NYSE:NOC) and has been awarded follow-on orders for welded structure assemblies for the E-2D Advanced Hawkeye (E-2D) aircraft. Under the terms of these new orders, WMI will manufacture more than 20 different complex welded assemblies in support of the production of E-2D aircraft with deliveries through 2028. “CPI Aero is proud to supply complex welded assemblies to Northrop Grumman under our NADCAP certification for fusion and resistance welding. We are currently approved to several Aerospace and Defense OEM weld specifications for multiple metals such as steel, aluminum, and titanium.
